composer.vector_hint: Redraw a scan/PDF into editable CAD. The description method first builds a complete coordinate graph of entities, text, dimensions and relations, then reproduces it without invention; incomplete graphs are blocked.
composer.vector_cleanup_tip: Tip: run a very dirty/dark photo through “Image → Cleanup” first, then digitize its result (“From generated”).
composer.digitization_type_hint: The type constrains the domain reader and generator. If reading does not confirm it, generation stops instead of substituting another part.
composer.read_passes_hint: What several passes agree on counts as read; what differs goes to a person instead of being filled in silently.
composer.vector_spec_hint: A model reads the source image into a structured spec, then a drafter builds clean geometry from it. This is a redraw, not a pixel copy — the result opens as a draft for review.
composer.vector_description_placeholder: Example: rectangular plate 120×80×10 mm with four Ø10H7 through holes centered at (±45, ±25) mm from the profile centre
composer.vector_description_hint: The drawing can be built without a source image. Missing dimensions are never invented: drafting stops with an explicit reason.
composer.vector_template_plate_text: Rectangular plate 120×80×10 mm. Two Ø10H7 through holes centered at (-45, 25) and (45, -25) mm from the profile centre.
composer.vector_template_flange_text: Circular flange Ø180, thickness 20 mm. Six Ø14H7 holes equally spaced on a Ø140 pitch circle, with the first hole to the right.
composer.vector_template_slot_text: Rectangular plate 100×60×8 mm. A through capsule slot at the centre, overall length 40 mm and width 12 mm, rotated 30° counter-clockwise.
composer.vector_autoscale_hint: The scale is chosen automatically from the standard series (GOST 2.302) to fit the selected sheet and orientation.
composer.vector_autoscale_need_sheet: Pick a sheet format — a standard scale (GOST 2.302) will be chosen automatically to fit it.
composer.vector_vlm_enrich_label: Refine dimensions/lines via VLM (slower, more accurate on uncertain spots)
composer.tech_hint: Deterministic vector drawing: exact dimensions, tolerances (quality grades), Ra roughness and a GOST title block. Shaft, plate/flange and assembly are supported.
composer.tech_placeholder: Stepped shaft: M24×2 thread, 25mm long; Ø45 h6 neck, 60mm long, Ra 0.8; Ø35 k6, 40mm long; material Steel 40Kh
composer.postprocess_hint: default is the raw ComfyUI result
composer.quality_hint_quality: ~2-3 min, much better odds of a correct result (not guaranteed)
composer.generated_source_no_result: This generation has no result yet.
composer.cleanup_prompt_placeholder: The workflow prompt will be shown here and can be edited
composer.cleanup_prompt_default: convert this into a clean black and white technical line drawing, crisp sharp outlines, remove background, remove noise and shadows, white background, engineering blueprint style
composer.placeholder_generate: drilling jig sketch for a flange, technical line drawing, top view
composer.placeholder_edit: remove the chamfer, add a 40h7 dimension, redraw the top view
composer.error_need_source: Attach an image for this operation.
composer.error_need_mask: Paint the area to edit on the image.
composer.workflow_add_need_import: No built-in template to copy — import your own workflow on the “Workflows” tab.
composer.workflow_params_hint: Current values apply to this run only.
composer.workflow_params_builtin_hint: Current values apply to the run; saving creates your own copy.
composer.workflow_params_saved_copy: Created a workflow copy with saved parameters.
composer.eskd_diffusion_hint: Diffusion ЕСКД pipeline: the description acts as the prompt. The result is ЕСКД-styled but not metrically exact.

vector.title: Digitized drawing
vector.fillet_chamfer_not_a_segment: Fillet/chamfer only work between straight segments — pick a line
vector.sketch_not_a_segment: This operation only works on segments — pick a straight line
vector.offset_bad_target: Offset works on a segment, circle or arc
vector.offset_pick_side: Click the side to offset toward
vector.block_needs_selection: Select geometry for the block first (marquee or Shift+click)
vector.block_not_found: Block "{name}" not found — the blocks command lists them
vector.block_pick_point: Click insertion points for block "{name}" (Esc to finish)
vector.block_list_empty: No blocks yet — select geometry and type: block name
vector.construction_hint: Construction (auxiliary) geometry — shown on the canvas but excluded from the DXF/SVG/PDF export
vector.mirror_pick_line: Click two points for the mirror line
vector.layers_hint: 🔒 lock — visible but not selectable; ❄ freeze — hidden and not selectable. Hover a layer name for its DXF layer, linetype and lineweight.
vector.print_pdf_hint: Server-rendered print PDF — the same layers, linetypes and lineweights as the DXF
vector.full_check_current: The current revision passed the full check
vector.full_check_required: A full check is required after the latest change
vector.validation_no_issues: No issues found at the current assurance levels
vector.spec_optional_missing: Optional data that can be completed before release
vector.spec_review_user_decides: The system saved its best constructed candidate but could not confirm the items below unambiguously. Compare it with the source: continue the checks and accept it if correct, or edit it if not.
vector.spec_review_no_geometry: The part contour could not be constructed automatically. The sheet is open for manual tracing and cannot be accepted without geometry.
vector.assurance_source_projection: Independent reading/view check against the source
vector.assurance_raster_skipped: The image comparison did NOT run
vector.assurance_raster_skipped_hint: no measurable circles on the sheet — the absence of errors here confirms nothing
vector.assurance_solid_built: Part built in 3D; the drawing comes from it
vector.solid_preview_hint: Rotate it and compare it with the source. This is not a finished part: unknown features are deliberately omitted, and STEP/STL or final DXF release remains blocked until they are completed.
vector.assurance_callouts: Dimensions on the sheet: {placed} of {read} read
vector.assurance_assumed_hint: These could not be read off the sheet. Check them against the original and correct them — the model is parametric, so rebuilding is instant.
vector.model_trace_title: What the model read and sent to 3D
vector.model_trace_hint: Three boundaries are shown: the saved reading, the exact CAD-kernel JSON, and the operations actually completed. SHA-256 binds the request to the build.
vector.model_trace_values: Accepted values: votes, confidence and source
vector.model_trace_kernel_result: What the CAD kernel actually built
vector.model_trace_not_built: The CAD kernel was not called; no built operations exist yet
vector.spec_editor_hint: This is what the model read off the sheet. The part, the drawing and the 3D model are all built from it — fix a number and rebuild instead of redrawing by hand. An amber border marks a value that was assumed, not read.
vector.spec_editor_assumed: Assumed, not read from the sheet
vector.spec_editor_m8_reference: Reference only, never auto-filled: standard coarse M8 pitch is 1.25 mm and a common tapping drill is Ø6.8 mm. Confirm against the source or technical requirements.
vector.spec_editor_m8_geometry: Standard-derived geometry: when M8 pitch is omitted, coarse pitch 1.25 mm is used and the finished thread basic minor diameter is D1 = 6.646835 mm. No manufacturing drill choice is inserted into part geometry.
vector.spec_editor_circular_patterns_hint: Verify entry face and angular phase. Count, diameter, PCD, depth and inclination stay separate from M8.
vector.spec_editor_rebuild_blocked: Final release is still blocked, but the review 3D draft can be rebuilt after every correction. Complete the marked fields; an M8 tap-drill diameter is not required.
vector.graph_vlm_evidence_title: VLM verification of text, dimensions and symbols
vector.accept_blocked_critical: {n} unconfirmed critical dimension(s)/label(s) — confirm or fix them in the review queue before accepting
vector.accept_blocked_review: {n} unresolved entities — finish the review queue before accepting
vector.accept_blocked_full_check: Run a full check for the current revision before accepting
vector.accept_blocked_unresolved: {n} unresolved region(s) — fix and confirm them before accepting
vector.cad_no_candidates: There is not enough confirmed contour geometry for a 3D model
vector.cad_confirm_assumptions: The selected 3D hypothesis contains {n} unconfirmed assumptions. Record them and build the model?
vector.cad_preview_error: The STL model could not be displayed
vector.cmd_hint: command or coordinates: 100,50 · @50,0 · @50<45 · line · circle · undo · fit
vector.parameter_expr_hint: A number (45) or an expression over other parameters: 2*height+5, sqrt(a*a)
vector.constraint_driven_hint: Driving (sets geometry) / driven reference (measures, not solved)
vector.constraints_select_hint: Select 1–2 entities on the canvas to add a constraint (Shift+click for two).
vector.constraint_value_required: Enter a numeric value for this constraint.
vector.constraint_no_refs: Could not determine reference points for the selected entities.
vector.set_sheet_format: Confirm sheet format {fmt} and derive scale
vector.release_hint: Download release package: DXF/SVG/CAD IR + hash manifest
vector.release_not_reproducible: ⚠ Artifacts do not match the source revision

cad.vectorizer_progress_summary: Web CAD corpus: {models} models → {sheets} exact sheets → {tiles} training tiles.
cad.vectorizer_quality_summary: Web layout F1: {layoutF1}; PDF holdout fields: lines {heatmapLineF1}, endpoints {endpointF1}, junctions {junctionF1}. Source-snapped graph: entity F1 {entityF1}, exact-sheet {exactRate}. On the honest native-DXF holdout CV reaches F1 {nativeDxfF1} with false-exact {falseExact}; the line-only candidate is rejected and multi-type CAD is next.
cad.reader_field_recall_status: Field reading measured on the labelled sheets (eval_reader_fields.py): diameters 1.00, fits 0.80, roughness 0.875. Reader qwen3-vl:30b-a3b, fragment questions with schemas. Dense shaft geometry still does not close on the overall length — the cross-check says so.
cad.pipeline_graph_experiment: Coordinate reader (experiment, not on the button)
cad.latest_real_regression: Latest live run: {dwg} DWG + {photos} photos; entity precision {precision}, recall {recall}, F1 {f1}; exact-sheet {exact}, false-exact {falseExact}. Gate failed.
cad.reconstruction_status: Sheet reproduction (redraw what was recognized and compare with the original ink — no ground truth needed): DWG recall {dwgR}, precision {dwgP}; photos recall {photoR}, precision {photoP}. This is NOT the entity F1 above, which compares the entity list against how the CAD file happened to split it.
cad.multi_type_candidate_status: Multi-type v2, checkpoint {step}: independent native-DXF holdout ({sheets} sheets) — proposal precision {precision}, recall {recall}, F1 {f1}; segment F1 {segmentF1}, text-anchor F1 {textF1}. OCR payload and relations are excluded. Candidate remains opt-in; gate failed.
cad.description_drafting_status: Drafting from description: deterministic reference set {passed}/{cases}, exact-case {exact}, DXF reopen {reopen}. This result covers only explicit values in supported profiles; unknown parameters block drafting.
cad.read_passes_hint: How many times to read the sheet: what agrees counts as read, what differs goes to a person
cad.pdf_page_invalid: PDF page must be an integer starting at 1
cad.empty: No drawings yet — create a sheet, import a DXF or digitize a scan in the studio.
cad.reading_kept_after_failure: The reading was kept. Open the specification, fill in what is missing and rebuild — the sheet does not have to be read again.
cad.reading_kept_note: The part could not be built from this reading. What is above is what you can rely on: fix what is missing and rebuild.
cad.blocked_solid_input: What would be sent to the 3D model
